'''Mechanical Allies''' was a shop, owned and operated by [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[San]], located on [[Sel Zonn Station]], specializing in the repair and sale of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Despite being run by a nonhuman and carrying mostly shoddy merchandise, the shop stayed open during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] due to the owner's business sense and some well-placed bribes.
